hypotheses.title: Refined Volume-Tilted LEAPS VRP with Short-Term Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines Candidate B (Sharpe 1.31, Fitness 1.05, Turnover 12.01%) by blending 90% volume-tilted LEAPS VRP with 10% short-term 3-day reversion. Shaves the remaining 0.038 off self-correlation (from 0.7381 to < 0.60) while maintaining ultra-low turnover.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if Sharpe falls below 1.25 or self-correlation remains >= 0.70.

hypotheses.title: Smoothed Customer Network Momentum with Short-Term Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Customer return signal (pv13_custretsig_retsig) smoothed with 5-day linear decay to reduce turnover, combined with short-term price mean-reversion. Operates in the customer-supplier network domain, making it completely orthogonal to option volatility alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if turnover exceeds 30% or Sharpe falls below 1.25.
